findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: web_agents, web_apis, web_commerce_agents, web_llms, web_mcp_registry, web_mcp_servers · Private data: air_passengers_monthly, airport_passengers, consumer_prices, court_rulings, court_rulings_by_court, debt_restructuring, debt_restructuring_by_age, domain_lookup, domains_dropped, domains_expiring, domains_new, domains_valuable, electricity_balance, electricity_forecast, foods, guest_nights, guest_nights_by_country, guest_nights_by_county, house_prices, job_ads, job_ads_national, medicine_shortages, medicine_shortages_by_group, medicine_shortages_monthly, municipal_figures, municipal_figures_latest, party_agreement, party_attendance, population, population_latest, riksbank_rates, stats_dnssec, stats_nameservers, swestr, train_punctuality, train_punctuality_daily, weather_history, weather_now, web_agents, web_ai_stance, web_apis, web_commerce_agents, web_llms, web_mcp_registry, web_mcp_servers · Public sink: debt_restructuring, party_agreement, stats_nameservers, train_punctuality.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
